answer: Written in a mathematical clarity, compound sentences linking proof generation to verification register, it stays short. The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Reaching the basalt of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the mirror of a task receipt, and the ridge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
